title: Contacts Manager
hints: One contact per line is enough for the file: `name|phone|email|tag1,tag2`. Read it back with `std::getline(lineStream, field, '|')`.
`std::map::find` returns `end()` when the name is not there; wrap that in a function returning `std::optional<Contact>` so the menu code reads `if (auto c{ find(name) }) ...` (lesson 10.04).
requirements: `struct Contact { std::string name, phone, email; std::vector<std::string> tags; };`
A `std::map<std::string, Contact>` keyed by name, so the list comes out sorted
Commands: add, delete, search (part of a name, ignoring case), list, list by tag
`std::optional<Contact>` (or a pointer) for "find one", so not-found is handled
Save the contacts to a text file when the program ends and load them when it starts
stretch: Save safely: write to `contacts.tmp`, then `std::filesystem::rename` it over the real file, so a crash halfway never loses the old one.
